column1: # FASA ingredient inclusion limits — safe/practical bounds on SINGLE-INGREDIENT inclusion.
# Nutrient composition alone is not enough to formulate on: an ingredient can satisfy every
# nutrient constraint and still be unusable at the level the LP picked (pellet durability
# extrudability
# carries the per-ingredient ceiling/floor a formulator would apply by hand.
# Effect on the LP: the bounds become the decision variable's box
#   min_inclusion <= x_code <= max_inclusion
# A max of 0 removes the ingredient from consideration entirely
# (the response then carries a "[limit]" warning naming it). A min only applies to
# ingredients the caller actually priced — the engine cannot force in an ingredient it has
# no price for.
# Columns:
#   code                FICD ingredient code (must be present in the ingredient pool).
#   species             blank = all. Exact match ("Nile Tilapia" | "African Catfish").
#   production_system   blank = all. Exact match ("General-LowCost" | "General").
#   stage_weight        blank = all. SUBSTRING match against the ASNS stage label
#                       "Starter" covers "< 5g (Starter)" (same convention as
#                       premix_mask.json stage_overrides).
#   processing_method   blank = all. Exact match ("pelleted" | "extruded") — the same
#                       ingredient often tolerates a higher rate in a pellet than in an
#                       extrudate
#   min_inclusion       mass FRACTION of total feed in [0
#                       Blank = 0 (no floor).
#   max_inclusion       mass FRACTION of total feed in [0
#                       Blank = no ceiling. A value outside [0
#   note                free text
# The API reports these bounds back as PERCENTAGES (max_inclusion_percent: 15.0); only
# this file and the request payload use fractions.
# When several rows match a request
column2: the most specific row wins (most non-blank scope
